## Know IIP

The International Institute of Professionals (IIP) was incorporated in the year 2012 under section 25 of the Companies Act, 1956 for bringing professionals under one umbrella in order to constitute a professional brain bank.

IIP, an NGO having 12A-80G-IT clearance, Certificate of CSR, Niti Ayog MSME Udyam registration, etc for various programmes /projects as a social philanthropic mission and nurturing professionals of various fields, bringing a silent revolution in professional upliftment, the next-gen leaders who will thrive in the professional world for building the nation and their country.

/industry/health-worker.title: Health Worker
/industry/health-worker.content:
Health systems can only function with health workers; improving health service coverage and realizing the right to the enjoyment of the highest attainable standard of health is dependent on their availability, accessibility, acceptability and quality.

WHO estimates a projected shortfall of 10 million health workers by 2030, mostly in low- and lower-middle income countries.

However, countries at all levels of socioeconomic development face, to varying degrees, difficulties in the education, employment, deployment, retention, and performance of their workforce.  
The chronic under-investment in education and training of health workers in some countries and the mismatch between education and employment strategies in relation to health systems and population needs are contributing to continuous shortages. These are compounded by difficulties in deploying health workers to rural, remote and underserved areas. Moreover, the increasing international migration of health workers may exacerbate health workforce shortfalls, particularly in low- and lower-middle income countries. Human resources for health information systems are often weak to take stock of selected health workers from the public sector.

In some countries, challenges in universal access to health workers may also result from the lack of capacity by the public sector to absorb the supply of health workers due to budgetary constraints. As a result, some countries face the paradox of health worker unemployment co-existing with major unmet health needs.

The High-Level Commission on Health Employment and Economic Growth identified six pathways by which investments in the health and social workforce can spur inclusive economic growth. The health workforce has a vital role in building the resilience of communities and health systems to respond to disasters caused by natural or artificial hazards, as well as related environmental, technological and biological hazards and risks. Seventy per cent (70%) of the health and social workforce are women and investing in the health workforce is an opportunity to create decent employment opportunities, in particular for women and youth.

- Venture capital financing is funding provided to companies and entrepreneurs. It can be provided at different stages of their evolution, although it often involves early and seed round funding.
- Venture capital funds manage pooled investments in high-growth opportunities in startups and other early-stage firms and are typically only open to accredited investors.
- Venture capital has evolved from a niche activity at the end of the Second World War into a sophisticated industry with multiple players that play an important role in spurring innovation.

Want to be a Venture Capital member? [Register now](#register)

/industry/volunteer-service.title: Volunteer Service
/industry/volunteer-service.content:
Volunteers are an essential resource for a sustainable nonprofit community. For many charities, a steady supply of individuals willing to give their most valuable resource—time—is critical for their basic operations. This report illustrates how donors support charitable causes with both their time and money—and how the COVID-19 crisis has sharply impacted how volunteers are able to serve.

/industry/wellness.title: Wellness
/industry/wellness.content:
Healthcare is a diverse field with many career options. /membership.title: Register as Member
/membership.content:
#### Patrons (Director's Council) (DCIIP)

[Subscribe](#register)

- The members of the Directors’ Council are the patrons of International Institute of Professional. They are appointed and/or nominated by the Chairman.

#### Elite Fellow (EFIIP)

[Subscribe](#register)

- The Directors’ Council will confer the ‘Elite Fellow’ title to eminent professionals in recognition of their achievements and contributions in their fields or society at large.
- Elite Fellow members will have permission to perform any activities like other members.

#### Honorary Member (HMIIP)

[Subscribe](#register)

- Honorary membership is the highest distinction that International Institute Of Professionals may bestow and will be conferred by International Institute Of Professionals only in exceptional cases.
- Honorary Membership is offered to a person/member who has distinguished themselves by meritorious service.
- Honorary members will have permission to perform any activities like other members.

#### Fellow Member (FMIIP)

[Subscribe](#register)

- The individual must be a professional of repute in his / her chosen profession for more than ten years and has made significant contributions to his / her profession.
- The members of International Institute Of Professionals for more than five years may be considered for being ‘Fellow’ of the institute after evaluating his / her application with due emphasis on his / her professional achievements.

#### Member (MIIP)

[Subscribe](#register)

- Should have attained the age of 30 years.
- Should be a professional (i.e. earning his / her livelihood through his / her profession or contributing significantly towards the development of a profession for more than five years).
- For the candidates, those who have passed any of the examinations conducted by International Institute of Professionals or done in collaboration with International Institute of Professionals, the minimum age criterion is relaxed to 25 years. However, the candidate must have at least three years of experience after completing the course / examination conducted by International Institute of Professionals or coordinated by International Institute of Professionals in any way.

#### Associate Member (AMIIP)

[Subscribe](#register)

- Should have attained the age of 25 years.
- Should be a professional (i.e. earning his / her livelihood through his / her profession or making contributions towards the development of a profession for at least three years).
- For the candidates, those who have passed any of the examinations conducted by International Institute of Professionals or done in collaboration with International Institute of Professionals or coordinated by International Institute Of Professionals in any way, the minimum age is relaxed to 19 years and they may not have any work experience.
- The Associate Member will not have any voting rights.
- This grade is applicable to the aspirants for the particular professional field.

#### Corporate Member (CMIIP)

[Subscribe](#register)

- The rights and privileges of corporate membership may in the case of a firm/company elected in their conventional name as a member of International Institute Of Professionals and the said firm/company will be represented by any partner/director/Management employee in such firm / company or by such person authorized by power of attorney or letter of procreation or otherwise to the satisfaction of the Managing Committee of International Institute Of Professionals.
- International Institute Of Professionals at its sole discretions may allow three persons nominated by the corporate to be member of International Institute Of Professionals at a time. All nominated persons credentials are subjected to scrutiny.

#### Institutional Members (IIIP)

[Subscribe](#register)

- Institutional membership will be in the name of a department, lab, research group or institution (university, company etc.) or research group by aggregating them for a specific cause or farmers group by aggregating them for a specific cause.
- The Institution may be represented by such person authorized by power of attorney or letter of procreation or otherwise to the satisfaction of the Managing Committee
- International Institute Of Professionals at its sole discretions may allow three persons nominated by the Institution to be member of International Institute Of Professionals and at a time. All nominated persons credentials will be subject to scrutiny.

#### Society Members (SIIP)

[Subscribe](#register)

- Society is the term to describe human beings together (collective, the sum of their social networks and social interactions). People form societies in order to gain greater benefits as a group that would not be possible separately.
- The society may be represented by such person authorized by power of attorney or letter of procreation or otherwise to the satisfaction of the Managing Committee
- International Institute Of Professionals at its sole discretions may allow three persons nominated by the Society to be member of International Institute Of Professionals and at a time. All nominated persons credentials will be subject to scrutiny

#### Senior Citizen Member (SCIIP)

[Subscribe](#register)

Senior citizens are defined as any person:

- Who has attained the age of sixty years or above.
- May have previous professional experience (i.e. earning/has earned his / her livelihood through his / her profession or contributed/contributing significantly towards the development of a profession for more than five years)

- The membership of Senior Citizen is subject to the satisfaction of the Managing Committee

#### Super Senior Citizen Members ( SSIIP )

[Subscribe](#register)

A Super Senior Citizen is an individual resident who is 80 years or above, at any time during the previous year.

- May have previous professional experience (i.e. earning/has earned his / her livelihood through his / her profession or contributed/contributing significantly towards the development of a profession for more than five years).
- The membership of Super Senior Citizen is subject to the satisfaction of the Managing Committee

#### Volunteer Members (VIIP)

[Subscribe](#register)

- Should have attained the age of 19 years.
- Should have previous experience of or willing to do Selfless activities.
- Volunteer members will have no earning from International Institute Of Professionals and all their earnings will be deposited to International Institute Of Professionals fund.
- The membership of Volunteer Members is subject to the satisfaction of the Managing Committee

#### Student Member (STIIP)

[Subscribe](#register)

For becoming ‘Student Member’, the applicants should fulfill the following eligibility criteria:

- Should have attained the age of 18 years.
- Should be a student from a recognized institute.
- For the candidates, those who have passed any of the examinations conducted by International Institute Of Professionals or done in collaboration with International Institute Of Professionals or coordinated by International Institute Of Professionals in any way can also be a part of Student Membership.
- The student Member will not have any voting right.
- The membership of Student Member is subject to the satisfaction of the Managing Committee

#### International Member (INIIP)

[Subscribe](#register)

The applicants should fulfill the following eligibility criteria:

- Legal citizen of any Country (other than India).
- Should have attained the age of 30 years.
- Should be a professional (i.e. earning his / her livelihood through his / her profession or contributing significantly towards the development of a profession for more than five years).
- The membership of International Member is subject to the satisfaction of the Managing Committee

#### NRI Member (NIIP)

[Subscribe](#register)

Overseas Indians, officially known as Non-Resident Indians or Persons of Indian Origin, are people of Indian birth or ancestry who live outside the Republic of India

- Should be Legal Citizen of India but residing in any country other than India.
- Should have attained the age of 30 years.
- Should be a professional (i.e. earning his / her livelihood through his / her profession or contributing significantly towards the development of a profession for more than five years).
- For the candidates, those who have passed any of the examinations conducted by International Institute Of Professionals or done in collaboration with International Institute Of Professionals, the minimum age criterion is relaxed to 25 years. However, the candidate must have at least three years of experience after completing the course / examination conducted by International Institute Of Professionals or coordinated by International Institute Of Professionals in any way.
